'''Da-Shek Yalaa''' was a legendary [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. He was honored in ancient paintings in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]&mdash;which also described four horrible wars in Kintan's past&mdash;discovered at some point around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="ARCH" />
